what: East West Bancorp is a US bank focused on serving businesses and individuals connecting the American and Chinese economies. It has branches in California, New York, Texas and greater China.
customers: Chinese-American households and businesses, companies trading between the US and Asia, and commercial borrowers in its markets.
money: commercial and industrial lending, commercial property and trade finance
deposits, mortgages and small business lending
moat: A cross-border niche that large banks find awkward and small banks cannot staff, with deposit relationships from a community that rarely moves banks.
risks: US-China tensions could disrupt the cross-border business that defines it
Commercial property lending is a watched exposure
Californian commercial property values have fallen
Concentration in one customer community is a risk as well as an advantage
opportunities: Net margin of 45%, among the highest of any US bank
Analysts see about 21% upside from current levels
watch: Deposit growth and commercial property credit metrics.
